properties.name: Tosh_Parvati_Valley
properties.description: Upper Parvati Valley AOI: Tosh and the surrounding settlements (Barshaini, Kutla, Pulga/Kalga/Tulga) on both banks of the Parvati river, Kullu district, Himachal Pradesh. Traced from the user-supplied Tosh_and_others.kml (Google Earth, 2026-08-11) with the polygon vertices unchanged. Placement cross-checked 2026-08-11: Pulga (31.99528N 77.43972E, Wikipedia) falls 4.5 km inside the polygon. ~436 km2, ~19 km E-W x 29 km N-S -- larger than the Ramban/Vaishno Devi corridors; a tighter polygon would sharpen targeting (NEW_AOI_PLAYBOOK step M1) but does not change the noise floor.
